test_modes.name: Object-dictionary readback
test_modes.purpose: SDO-read every supported OD entry to verify the device against its EDS.

test_modes.name: PDO mapping verification
test_modes.purpose: Verify the configured PDO mapping (0x1600 / 0x1A00) and transmission types.

test_modes.name: LSS (CiA 305)
test_modes.purpose: Inquire/assign Node-ID and bit-timing over the bus to bring up unconfigured nodes.

spec_provided_observability.name: SDO read of object dictionary
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read any OD entry by index/sub-index (device type 0x1000, error register 0x1001, identity 0x1018, error field 0x1003).

spec_provided_observability.name: EMCY emergency object
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reports an internal error with a 16-bit error code, the error register, and manufacturer bytes.

spec_provided_observability.name: Pre-defined error field (0x1003)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Array of the most recent emergency error codes (error history).

spec_provided_observability.name: Heartbeat / node guarding
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Liveness and NMT state observability of each node.

spec_provided_observability.name: NMT state
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Current device state (Initialisation / Pre-operational / Operational / Stopped) reported in heartbeat / guarding.

error_detection_mechanisms: SDO abort transfer with a 32-bit abort code on a failed OD access.
EMCY emergency object on an internal error event.
Heartbeat / node-guarding timeout detects a lost node.
Error register (0x1001) bit-flags the active error classes.
Underlying CAN error frames / error counters (CAN data link layer).
notes: CANopen exposes its observability through the object dictionary (SDO-readable entries), the EMCY emergency object and pre-defined error field (0x1003), heartbeat / node-guarding liveness, and the NMT state reported in those messages. Lower-level frame errors are handled by the CAN data link layer beneath CANopen. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain controller-vendor / SoC concerns.
